schema: functions: name -> orig (SEG:OFFSET), size_orig (to the next start), status (open, exact), kind (proven: a call target; candidate: after an unconditional ret/jump, no jump reaches it), module (a guess unless noted), note (by hand: an odd source form, a guessed name, dead code).
compiler: sccvc by measurement (comm2.c: the shipped scc, sccv1, sccv1c, sccvk, sccvl differ in the register variables of leaf functions, sccvc is masked-equal); the date (03/83) names v1: not decided, the owner

genquads.note: genquads(p): the quads of a tree (the operands p1 p2 p3 of the node: struct qa, p3 the result; qop[] gives the quad op of the node op). Open: (1) every assignment of a local structure (s4 = *p3, lcopy = *left, rcopy = *right) has `and r0,#%7f00` behind the lda in all our compilers, the original has none (a codegen difference of the original compiler: phase B, needs a switch: FNC_DROP='^and\sr0,#ADDR$' in fncheck.py hides it); (2) `p3->b2 = 0` uses rr0 in ours, rr2 in the original; (3) the end of the function: the original has one `ldir` sequence for `*p = rcopy` and `*p = lcopy` behind the operator chain (the sources of the copy are loaded in two places and jump to it), ours two. The case blocks 4:0e34 ... 4:11a4 are the cases of its switch; the order of the cases in the source is that of the code (0x46 group, 0x3a, 0x38, 0xa, 0x4e, 0x4f, 0x65, 0x7a, default); the INCR and DECR blocks are written twice (popt merges the tail); `p3->w4 -= 1` (not `p3->w4--`) gives the original code; `0e80` is the `qop == 7` block moved behind the first case

map.note: map(p, f, t): ?: && || and the comma are made into jumps (f, t: the labels of the context). Written as 4 blocks with their own locals (the frame slots overlap: the original reuses them). Source forms found: `lab = (long)t == 0 ? newtmpno() : t`, `return map(l) || map(r)` (the ldk r2,#1/#0), mknode(.., 0L) (a long 0 as the type), `ncopy(p, p->in.right)` before q is freed, y = c = talloc(); ncopy(y, t1) (not ncopy(y = c = talloc(), ..): that makes a frame temporary). The code is twice as likely repeated as shared in the source: popt merges the tails. The ANDAND/OROR branches test f and t twice (dead tests, kept)

writeil.note: writeil(): the quads are written (4:4a8e .. 4:53ea, 12 cases of the quad op: 0x2e start of the function, 0x11 its end with the S lines and the temp size, 6 and 0x3b tables, 0x1a 0x1c labels, 9 and 0x32 the call arguments (pend: the list of the arguments), 0x28 0x29 0x2b the registers and the symbols). 630 instructions equal in number; open: the loop of case 0x32 (q = q->next)->op: the original reads q->op with the displacement (ld r2,rr2(#4)), ours increments the address first; tried the comma operator and for(;;). The printf of the R and T lines: the order of the arguments is (a, -offset, type). printf("") before the second list of 0x3b is in the original (an empty format at 4:3950)

mktree.note: mktree(q): a quad is added to the tree (4:53f0 .. 4:5f38: the cases 4:584a ... 4:5d0e are blocks of it). Written complete; open: (1) the layout: in the original the case 0x7b stands right behind the dispatch and the common code of the switch (4:5872 ..) follows it, the other cases lie between its parts (after the unconditional jump at 4:593e), ours has the cases in a block (jump forms jp against jr, 283 lines of moved blocks; popt code motion, phase B); (2) `if (p->in.op == 0x7e)` reloads p from the frame in the original, ours forwards it. The float compares: GE of a float becomes FGT (0x5f, not FGE 0x5e: the original bug, kept); ctpos[c]-- <= 2 decides if the result is assigned to a temporary; 0 - x becomes unary minus; pend (4:3812) is a static pointer
